items.prompt: A function only calls print(6) and has no explicit return. What value does its caller receive?

options.text: The integer 6 because it appeared on the screen
options.why: Printed output and returned value are separate channels.
Printing does not return the printed string.

options.text: None, despite the visible printed output
options.why: Falling off the function returns None.

options.text: An exception because every function needs return
options.why: An explicit return statement is not compulsory.

items.explanation: A function without an explicit returned value returns None. Its output may still contain 6 because printing is a side effect.
